clue.text: A fine layer of shells from America

definitions.text: A fine layer of shells from America

parts.note: reads like a coating of seashells, but a layer here is a hen and the shells are eggshells
points to the US state that names this breed of chicken

explanation.walkthrough: A layer is a hen that lays eggs; this one is a breed named after the smallest US state.
explanation.definitionFit: The breed is a famous egg-laying chicken developed in New England, so it is a good producer of shelled eggs from America.

indicators.note: to rewrite something is to set it down afresh, so these letters are put in a new order

parts.note: the fodder: the twelve letters of these two words, rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone who lives somewhere is copying out the items in their journal.
explanation.definitionFit: Residentiary is a rare word for a resident, someone obliged to live in a place, such as a canon living at a cathedral.

clue.text: Switch upstanding doctor with composer right away

indicators.note: in a down clue, standing up means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: Dr No is the Bond villain, so No is a doctor

indicators.note: right away tells us the abbreviation for right is sent off from the composer's name

parts.note: Carl Orff, German composer of Carmina Burana

explanation.surface: An honest medic swaps places with a musician immediately.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Right away' looks like 'immediately'; it means remove R.
explanation.definitionFit: An on-off switch is the simple kind that toggles a device between its two states.

parts.note: ex- means former, as in an ex-wife
people who tend the sick are tenders

explanation.surface: Retired nurses are supplying the stretchers for carrying patients.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface makes stretchers the hospital kind; here they are things that stretch.
explanation.definitionFit: Extenders lengthen things, which is exactly what stretchers do.

indicators.note: to manipulate is to handle and shift about, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: the fodder: the seven letters of these two words, rearranged

explanation.surface: A boss pulls the strings of our Members of the European Parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: A supremo is a person in overall charge, an informal word for a chief.

parts.note: looks like an adjective meaning speedy, but is a noun: a cue given to a speaker
suggests a fast paper round, but is the screen a newsreader reads from

explanation.walkthrough: Read 'prompt' as quick and it sounds like an efficient newspaper delivery; it is really the device that prompts a presenter.
explanation.definitionFit: This trade name is the screen showing scrolling text that a television presenter reads while appearing to look at the camera.

indicators.note: the turned-round cross surrounds and guards the letter for new
turned upside down, which in a down clue means read from the bottom

parts.note: a rood is a crucifix, especially one in a church

explanation.surface: An upside-down crucifix shields a freshly made heavenly being.
explanation.walkthrough: An angel is also a financial backer, especially of a theatre show.
explanation.definitionFit: In theatre slang an angel is a backer who gives money to a production, which makes them a giver of funds.

clue.text: She possesses the will to work

definitions.text: She possesses the will to work

parts.note: sounds like a woman's determination, but the will is a legal document she holds
her job is to carry out the terms of that document

explanation.walkthrough: 'The will to work' sounds like keenness; it is a testament she must put into effect.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the old feminine form of executor, the person named to carry out the instructions in someone's testament.

parts.note: LA is a lap with its last letter clipped, and a lap is one round of a racetrack
an electrical fault in which current takes the wrong path

explanation.walkthrough: LA looks like Los Angeles; it is LAP with its end missing, so a circuit made short.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names an electrical fault where current bypasses its intended path, and also describes a lap with its last letter cut.

clue.text: It's clear journalist obtained a licence

parts.note: patent means obvious, as in a patent lie
ED is short for editor, the crossword's standard journalist

explanation.surface: A reporter has clearly secured official permission for something.
explanation.definitionFit: To have patented an invention is to have secured the exclusive right, a kind of official licence, to make and sell it.

parts.note: suggests paratroops, but simply means working in a plane
suggests women in the armed services, but means women serving passengers

explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as a military unit; the service is cabin service.
explanation.definitionFit: These are female flight attendants, who serve food and drink to passengers on board aircraft.

clue.text: In circulation, a vein is green

indicators.note: moving round, as blood circulates, so these letters go round into a new order

parts.note: the fodder: the five letters of these two words, rearranged

explanation.surface: A blood vessel seen moving blood looks green under the skin.
explanation.definitionFit: Green describes someone inexperienced and innocent, the same sense as this word for an unworldly person.

indicators.note: in some way or other, so the remaining letters are put in any order
the engineers get out of the word, so their letters are removed

parts.note: the fodder, taken as written, from which the engineers are removed
RE is the Royal Engineers, a corps of the British Army

explanation.surface: Disguised army engineers manage to avoid being identified.
explanation.definitionFit: Going about masked means being in disguise, keeping your identity hidden.

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to topple a ruler or government
second meaning: in cricket, an extra run scored when a fielder's throw goes past the stumps

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a wild throw to the stumps that nobody stops lets the batsmen run again; that bonus run has this name.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both the forced removal of a regime and a cricketing extra from an errant throw.

clue.text: Puts on trousers held by supporters

indicators.note: the trousers sit inside the supporters, gripped by them

parts.note: golf tees support the ball
Levi's is the jeans brand

explanation.surface: Someone pulls on trousers kept up by braces, the British word for suspenders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Puts on' looks like dressing; it means broadcasting, as a channel puts on a show.
explanation.definitionFit: A channel that puts on a programme shows it on air, which is broadcasting it on screen.

indicators.note: letters in motion are moving about into a new order

parts.note: the fodder: the nine letters of these two words, rearranged

explanation.surface: A perpetual-motion machine that keeps climbing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perpetual motion' reads as one phrase, but motion is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe something that never stops, continuing without pause.

clue.text: I relate changes to the workshop

indicators.note: the letters are altered in order

parts.note: the fodder: the seven letters of these two words, rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone reports alterations made to their workplace.
explanation.definitionFit: An atelier is an artist's or designer's studio, a workroom where things are made.

clue.text: A city to run to following heart transplant

indicators.note: the second to comes after, following the altered word

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the heart of the word run, its middle letter, is swapped for a new one like a donor organ

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone must dash somewhere to recover after cardiac surgery.
explanation.walkthrough: The central U of 'to run to' is replaced by O.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the largest city in Canada, capital of the province of Ontario.

parts.note: the lux is the unit of illumination
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A pale gold glow over a city in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Luxor is a city on the Nile in Egypt, on the site of ancient Thebes.

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
Michael Grade, the British television executive who ran the BBC and ITV

explanation.surface: A memo about Michael and the Marks & Spencer chain changing things.
explanation.walkthrough: Marks looks like a person or the store Marks & Spencer; here it means exam marks.
explanation.definitionFit: To regrade is to assess again and change the marks given to a piece of work.

clue.text: Pass up garland to soldiers showing spirit

indicators.note: handing something up a down clue means its letters are read from the bottom

parts.note: a lei is a Hawaiian flower garland
RA is the Royal Artillery

explanation.surface: Handing a flower wreath up to the troops lifts their morale.
explanation.definitionFit: Ariel is the airy spirit who serves Prospero in Shakespeare's The Tempest.

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a setback or military ...

explanation.walkthrough: It reads as a question with the answer 'victory'; instead the two halves each define the same word.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both the contrary of something and a setback suffered in battle.

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to wash out with water
second meaning: a hair tint, the blue or purple kind associated with older ladies

explanation.walkthrough: A 'blue rinse' is a tint worn by elderly women, sometimes with a purple tinge.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a wash through with clean water and a temporary dye for the hair.

clue.text: Mafia advocates opening peace moves, reportedly

parts.note: the Mafia originated in Sicily
the barristers for the accused are the defence

explanation.surface: Mob lawyers are starting negotiations for a truce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Peace' is heard as 'piece', so the definition is a chess opening, a set of piece moves.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a popular chess opening in which Black answers 1.e4 with c5, a sequence of piece moves.

indicators.note: the answer is a section cut from these words

parts.note: the answer runs from the end of walls through in and into usual

explanation.surface: Builders' talk of cavity walls in a standard cross-section.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cavity walls' reads as one building term, but cavity alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A sinus is an air-filled hollow in the bones of the skull.

clue.text: Rides large waves around the ship

indicators.note: the waves go round the ship

parts.note: rollers are long heavy waves
a coaster is a vessel trading along the coast

explanation.surface: Someone rides big waves surging about the vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: These are funfair rides of cars running on steep, twisting tracks.
